description: Latch edge logic: a guarded-throw transition that is a no-op because the latch is already in the target state (action never runs, reports ok), revert-after-failure followed by a successful manual transition, and conditional runners exercised from the on state.

cases.expected_output:
switch_off_throw -> ok
is_off -> true
is_on -> false

switch_on_throw -> ok
is_on -> true
is_off -> false

switch_on_throw -> error=action_failed
switch_on -> true
is_on -> true
switch_off_throw -> error=action_failed
is_off -> false

if_on -> true
if_off -> false
while_on -> true
while_off -> false

switch_on -> false
switch_off -> true
switch_off -> false
switch_on -> true
